title: Clicking tasks and goals in Whole project types them into the session's prompt

requirements.text: In Whole project opened from a session's panel, clicking an open task or goal types its shorthand into that session's prompt without pressing Return, closes the sheet and focuses the terminal
requirements.check: drive: fake claude records its input; text arrives, no newline

requirements.text: Shift-clicking marks several tasks and goals; releasing Shift types all of them at once, in the order clicked
requirements.check: drive: two shift-clicks then release -> one line with both

requirements.text: The shorthand is 'task NAME' / 'goal NAME' using short names, comma separated with a trailing space, and every name resolves with genlock show
requirements.check: swift test: PromptPicks formatting; genlock show on the short names

requirements.text: From the dashboard's Whole project (no session), picks go to the project's last shown session, or a new one when it has none, which is brought forward
requirements.check: swift test for target choice; drive

evidence: drive2: plain pick from the panel -> fake claude's raw input 'task refund-button ' with no CR/LF; report focused=alpha, route=sessions. Sheet closes via onChange(model.picksTyped) -> dismiss(); closing was not observed (sheet rendered off screen)

drive2/drive3: two shift-picks then Shift up -> one input 'goal payroll, task invoice-export ' / 'task invoice-export, task refund-button ' in click order; drive3 marked.png shows badges 1 and 2; a mark in another project is dropped (stray test). Shift up driven via model.shiftReleased(), same call the key monitor makes
PromptPicksTests: text == 'goal payroll, task refund-button, task T-CCCCC ' (no CR/LF); goal short resolves with 'genlock goal show payroll'; task shorts resolve with genlock show (existing tests)
PromptPicksTests target: panel session > last shown > first > nil; drive2: pick in beta with no session started one and typed 'goal status-page ' into it, focused=beta
node tests/run.mjs 416/0; swift test 110 tests 0 failures

answers.observed: fake claude input files and marked.png in scratchpad/drive2, drive3
answers.cause: first-pick loss in one run traced to the fake's stty startup race; gone with a longer start
answers.absence: real Shift key-up event and the sheet closing were not observed: runs are in the background so as not to take focus
answers.assumption: a new session takes under 4s to draw Claude Code's prompt; my choice, untested against real Claude
answers.falsify: a pick into a project with no session on a slow start, where the text never appears

what: A new session gets picks after a fixed 4s; a slow Claude Code start would lose them
verify: From the dashboard's Whole project, pick a task in a project with no open session and check the prompt shows it

text: Done: pick buttons in Whole project rows type 'task NAME'/'goal NAME' into the panel's session (or last shown, or a new one), shift-click several, order badges. Also removed the tabLabel goal fallback for T-DZBYH. Uncommitted.
